properties.title: USTR notice (2026-11-10): Notice of Product Exclusion Extensions: China's Acts, Policies, and Practices Related to Technology Transfer, Intellectual Property, and Innovation
properties.summary: Action: Notice. In prior notices, the U.S. Trade Representative (Trade Representative) modified the actions in the Section 301 investigation of China's acts, policies, and practices related to technology transfer, intellectual property, and innovation by excluding from additional duties certain products of China. While most exclusions have expired in prior years, certain exclusions remain in force. This notice announces the Trade Representative's determination to further extend all 178 current exclusions. Later dates named in its DATES paragraph: 2027-01-09. Federal Register document 2026-22925.

properties.title: BIS rule (2026-11-09): Extension of the Suspension of Expansion of End-User Controls for Affiliates of Certain Listed Entities
properties.summary: Action: Final rule; stay. The Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) is extending the suspension of the interim final rule (IFR), "Expansion of End-User Controls to Cover Affiliates of Certain Listed Entities."
